:root[data-theme=terminal] input[type=checkbox]{appearance:none;background:linear-gradient(var(--muted-2),var(--muted-2)) left top/3px 1px no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--muted-2),var(--muted-2)) right top/3px 1px no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--muted-2),var(--muted-2)) left bottom/3px 1px no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--muted-2),var(--muted-2)) right bottom/3px 1px no-repeat;border:0;border-inline:1px solid var(--muted-2);width:17px;height:17px;color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;border-radius:0;place-content:center;display:inline-grid}

:root[data-theme=terminal] body:after,:root[data-theme=terminal].deluge-deck-hosted #deluge-deck-root:after{content:"";z-index:80;pointer-events:none;opacity:.025;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 180 180' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.88' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Cpath fill='%23fff' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='.6' d='M0 0h180v180H0z'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");position:fixed;inset:0}
@media (width>=761px) and (height>=541px),(width>=951px){:root[data-theme=terminal] body .topbar-heading:before{content:"[ CLI TORRENT CLIENT v1.0 ]";font-size:19px}}

@media (width>=761px) and (height>=541px),(width>=951px){:root[data-theme=terminal] body .deck-status-rail svg,:root[data-theme=terminal] body .deck-status-rail .status-rail-spacer,:root[data-theme=terminal] body .deck-status-rail>span:nth-child(n+3):not(.status-ip),:root[data-theme=terminal] body .status-free-space>span{display:none}}

:root[data-theme=terminal] body .stat-card span,:root[data-theme=terminal] body .stat-card strong,:root[data-theme=terminal] body .table-shell th,:root[data-theme=terminal] body .session-quick-actions button{font-weight:400!important}
